title: Future plans: 'Visit Harlem with Sammy Price' and school work
summary: He plans Harlem tours and school programs with Larry Ridley.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well, what do you want me to say. Want to talk about anything? What my plans are for the future?
Well, you're going to Europe now for a good stretch and then, when you come back, there's the Committee, and what else?

Yeah. The Committee and I'm organizing this "Visit Harlem with Sammy Price" as a guest of Sammy Price. I'm organizing the thing where that I escort people. My daughter... the one that was driving us yesterday...will be driving. I'm getting a Suburban...hold about 25 people and I'm getting two big, husky guys in uniform, and myself. And we're bringing people to Harlem. Taking them around and showing them Harlem. Give them a safe conduct escort, and meeting the natives...you know as a rule you know you catch one of them sightseeing buses come to a guy's house, make a picture through the window glass and all that business. We won't do that, Dan. Person want a picture, we will have a friendly rapport with people that he can make a

picture with. And all in all I predict a bright future for jazz. I think I'm going to...what I want to try to do is work very closely with that boy...what's his name? From the school that play the bass?

Larry...people like that. I want to work closely with them and do what I can do to help. Because Boogie-Woogie can fit in anyplace, you know, and I could explain what it is, you know what I mean, and sometime this is good. This may be an interesting item for youngsters to see. Well, I certainly would like to have Larry involved with me and try to get it in the schools.
Yeah, he is on a committee at the National Endowment for the Arts...Music in Schools. And...
